summary: Avoid redundant per-request session attribute writes in OpenmrsFilter
description:
Background
On every request, OpenmrsFilter sets the session's username attribute to an anonymous placeholder and then immediately overwrites it for authenticated users, re-sets the locale attribute even when unchanged (marking the session dirty for replicating session managers), and stores a per-request timestamp attribute that nothing in core reads.
Requested change
Only write session attributes when their values actually change, and remove (or make lazy) the unused unique-id attribute. Session creation behavior is intentionally out of scope and must not change.
Acceptance criteria
Session attributes end up with the same values as today for anonymous and authenticated requests.

No attribute writes occur when values are unchanged.

Tests cover both user states.
